description.value: The Witch Liquor Store is one of 13 Springs Group retail locations across British Columbia, situated on Dewdney Trunk Road in Maple Ridge. It stocks an extensive range of ice-cold beer, coolers, ciders, fine wines, and spirits, with curbside pickup and home delivery also available. Frequent promotional deals and knowledgeable staff make it a well-regarded neighbourhood liquor stop for anyone riding through the Maple Ridge area.

address.value: 22644 Dewdney Trunk Rd. Maple Ridge, BC V2X 3J9

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 75m; rack at 79m; rack at 93m; rack at 96m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at springsgroup.ca/locations/the-witch-liquor-store/ clearly confirms this is an active Springs Group retail liquor store at 22644 Dewdney Trunk Rd, Maple Ridge, BC V2X 3J9, with phone (604) 476-9463 and email witchlrs@springsgroup.ca. The site explicitly promotes curbside ordering and liquor delivery, confirming takeout availability. No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water, washrooms, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the website or in OSM tags, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM record contains no address or phone — both sourced from website only.

The location page includes the phrase 'Reserve your table today!' which appears to be a copy-paste error from the associated Witchcraft pub page; this store is a retail liquor outlet, not a restaurant.
URL was discovered with only medium confidence, though the page content unambiguously matches the OSM business name and category.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active retail liquor store with confirmed address, phone, and current web presence. A legitimate stop for touring cyclists needing supplies in Maple Ridge.
